title: ferrion.jsonc
description: The configuration of Ferrion, the Java formatter and linter. Generated by `cargo codegen` (tools/codegen) from crates/ferrion_config/src/keys.rs.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editors.

configs.description: The config entries, in order: for each file, later entries that match it win.

plugins.description: The rule plugins to load, by name.

reportUnusedDisableDirectives.description: The level at which to report a disable comment that disables nothing.

linterOptions.description: Options of the linter as a whole.

baseline.description: The baseline file, relative to the working directory.

name.description: A name for the entry, shown in `ferrion config` and in errors.

files.description: Globs of the files the entry applies to, relative to the working directory. Without it, the entry applies to every `*.java` file.

ignores.description: Globs of files the entry doesn't apply to. In an entry with only `ignores` (and `name`), the files are left out of every run.

rules.description: Rule settings: a level, or an object with `level` and `options`. The last matching entry that mentions a rule gives its whole setting.

enabled.description: Whether `ferrion format` formats the files. It does unless this is false.

format.description: Formatter settings. The last matching entry with `format` gives all of them.

glob.description: A glob, relative to the working directory, with `/` between folders. `*` doesn't match `/`, and `**` as a whole segment matches any number of folders.
